title: Emergency rule for relocating fire-destroyed liquor licenses
summary: On September 9, 2026, the commission voted unanimously to reauthorize its emergency rule on liquor license relocation for premises destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires. The rule lets an applicant ask for a hearing before the commission to make the case for using a relocation application. In November 2024, the commission approved a renewed version that added a paragraph number six missing the month before.
